name: ambilight
description: Reproduces on-screen edge colors on LED groups mapped to screen sides

parameters.name: device_index
parameters.description: Index of the USB video capture device, as enumerated by OpenCV/V4L2 (e.g. /dev/video0 = 0).

parameters.name: edge
parameters.description: Physical screen edge this group samples from: 'top', 'bottom', 'left', or 'right'.

parameters.name: reversed
parameters.description: Reverses LED sampling order along the edge to match physical strip wiring direction.

parameters.name: band_depth_percent
parameters.description: Depth of the sampled edge band as a percentage of the screen's perpendicular dimension (e.g. 20% of screen height for a 'left' edge).

parameters.name: weight_exponent
parameters.description: Exponent applied to distance-based pixel weighting within the band; higher values bias the average toward pixels closest to the physical screen edge.
